about: Hand-labelled job families for three seeded samples of Google postings, labelled from each title alone by the google-grouping lane (docs/process/google-grouping.md). "tuning": 120 postings of the 2026-10-11 beta snapshot (mulberry32 seed 20261011 over the sorted ids), labelled before the classifier was first run on them; the rules were then adjusted with them in view. "held-out": 100 more postings of that snapshot (seed 7, excluding the first sample), drawn and labelled after the rules were frozen. "fresh": 100 postings of the 2026-10-16 crawl whose id and title are not in the 2026-10-11 snapshot (seed 1016), drawn and labelled after the rules were frozen. Used by test/google-grouping.test.js.
